#### Skeletal muscle:

+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Sarcomere                  | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2011/A/12/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Sarcomere with actin, myosin and A, I, H and M bands"} |
+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Excitation and contraction | - Action potential at motor nerve terminal                                                                             |
|                            | - Depolarisation of post-junctional membrane                                                                           |
|                            | - Activation of L-Ca^2+^ channels                                                                                      |
|                            | - Ca^2+^ influx                                                                                                        |
|                            | - Ca^2+^ triggered Ca^2+^ release from sarcoplasmic reticular L-Ca^2+^ channel                                         |
|                            | - Ca^2+^ binds troponin C                                                                                              |
|                            | - Troponin removes tropomyosin from actin                                                                              |
|                            | - Actin-myosin cross-bridge cycling occur                                                                              |
+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Single twitch vs tetanic contraction:

+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                             | **Single twitch**                    | **Tetanic contraction**                                    |
+=============================================+======================================+============================================================+
| Definition                                  | - Single contraction then relaxation | Continuous fused contraction                               |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Cause of onset                              | - Single nerve action potential      | - Repeated nerve action potential and cross-bridge cycling |
|                                             |                                      | - Time between APs shorter than time to peak force         |
|                                             |                                      | - Slow twitch 100ms duration hence \>\>10Hz                |
|                                             |                                      | - Fast twitch 10ms duration hence \>\>100Hz                |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Cause of offset                             | - ACh metabolism and reuptake        | - Cessation of nerve action potential                      |
|                                             | - Ca^2+^ reuptake and extrusion      | - Then ACh metabolism and uptake                           |
|                                             |                                      | - Ca^2+^ reuptake and extrusion                            |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Duration                                    | - Same each time                     | - Variable.                                                |
|                                             | - 10-100msec                         | - Until fatigue or voluntary cessation                     |
|                                             | - (Fast → slow fibre)                |                                                            |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Force developed                             | - Same each time                     | - 4x ↑tension possible                                     |
|                                             | - Less                               |                                                            |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Inertia to be overcome                      | - More                               | - Less (only present at the start)                         |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Energy consumed overall                     | - Less overall                       | - More overall                                             |
|                                             | - More per time                      | - Less per time                                            |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect of depolarizing NMBD                 | - ↓Height                            | - No fade                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect of non-depolaring NMBD               | - ↓Height                            | - Fade                                                     |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
| Sensitivity for detecting residual blockade | - Low                                | - Very high                                                |
+---------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------+
